title: GTA 6 Has Slow Motion: How to Use Focus (L3 + R3) ⏱️ #Shorts
description:
GTA 6 has a slow-motion ability called Focus. Click both sticks (L3 + R3) to turn it on; it unlocks in Chapter 1 during the mission "Down to Earth". In gunfights it marks red (lethal) and yellow (non-lethal) spots, it highlights engines, fuel tanks and tires, slows time while driving, tracks animals and spots fish. The purple bar refills over time, faster with coffee or tea, or by sleeping and showering at your safehouse. Shooting ranges, golf, pool and fishing extend it permanently.

Sources: Shacknews (How to unlock Focus mode in GTA 6), GTABase (GTA 6 Focus ability explained).
Images: Rockstar Games (An Extended Look).
